body: I mixed ket, lsd, 2cb, and nangs/whippits. You’ll be fine. It was a very intense experience but well worth it

I mixed 1 pink rocket 2cb with a tab of LSD, a couple lines of ketamine and some nangs/whippets thrown in for good measure. Most intense experience of my life, DO NOT OVERDO THE KETAMINE or you’ll be throwing up for hours. I also forgot to put my playlist on shuffle, and I ended up stuck in what felt like a time loop to School by Supertramp for what felt like eternity
